name: bevel-hero
title: Bevel Hero
description: Inspired by the bevel.health website design — a clean white editorial hero with a bold Georgia serif headline, eyebrow social-proof text, and an infinite auto-scrolling strip of portrait reel cards (Instagram-style). Each card shows a Cloudinary image with a user avatar, like/comment counts, and caption overlays. Left and right white gradient fades complete the marquee effect. Entrance animations powered by motion/react with staggered delays on eyebrow, headline, sub-copy, and the reel strip.
